title: [GMCP 203.021.06] Operations and evidence: Local MCP gateway, reverse proxy, and aggregation plane
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-021-06. Ship inspectable CLI, TUI or API state, configuration validation, bounded metrics/logs/traces, diagnostics, examples, migration and rollback guidance, incident runbooks, and reproducible evidence artifacts. Automate drift detection so a changed dependency or standard invalidates stale proof. Vector outcome: GMCP exposes many local or remote servers as one policy-enforced endpoint while preserving original server identity, capabilities, schemas, errors, progress, cancellation, subscriptions and trace context. Routing and transformation are deterministic; backpressure, quotas and failure isolation prevent one backend from harming others; and direct-versus-gateway differential tests prove no semantic loss. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
